versions.subject: Merge PR #4626 from @AdmU3 - Add New Rules Related To `tar.exe` Usage
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\tar.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'bsdtar'
selection_extract:
    CommandLine|contains: '-x'
condition: all of selection_*
